nodes.description: The rate-limiting state. MBD4-deficient AMLs carry about 33 times the mutation burden of AML generally and MBD4-deficient colorectal adenomas several times that of sporadic adenomas, in both cases more than 95% CpG>TpG transitions, at sites that are methylated in the normal tissue, accumulating steadily with age. The signature (sometimes labelled SBS1-MBD4 or SBS96) closely resembles the clock-like COSMIC SBS1, so MBD4 deficiency is best understood as an acceleration of the ordinary age-related CpG mutation process rather than a new mutational process.
